const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab put_two_mugs_on_shelf episode control and observation log.
+
+Usage: python /app/output/gen.py obs|status|move X Y Z YAW_DEG GRIP|hold SECONDS
+The camera geometry and calibration are saved in spec.json and the runs directory.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+ROOT = Path("/app")
+OUT = ROOT / "output"
+RUNS = ROOT / "runs"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+LOG = OUT / "episode.jsonl"
+
+
+def record(item):
+    with LOG.open("a") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(item, default=float) + "\n")
+
+
+def save_result(r, result, label):
+    idx = len(list(RUNS.glob("[0-9][0-9][0-9]_*"))) + 1
+    folder = RUNS / f"{idx:03d}_{label}"
+    result.save(str(folder))
+    print("saved", folder)
+    print("done", result.meta.get("done"), "reason", result.meta.get("reason"),
+          "steps", result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk", result.meta.get("control_steps_watch")),
+          "plan", result.meta.get("plan"), "time_left", result.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    print("tcp", np.round(result.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], 4).tolist(),
+          "opening", round(result.meta["proprio"]["now"][24], 4))
+    return folder
+
+
+def pose(x, y, z, yaw):
+    reset_quat = [0.0, -0.7071067811865476, 0.7071067811865476, 0.0]
+    base = Rotation.from_quat([reset_quat[1], reset_quat[2], reset_quat[3], reset_quat[0]])
+    rot = Rotation.from_euler("z", yaw, degrees=True) * base
+    q = rot.as_quat()
+    return [x, y, z, q[3], q[0], q[1], q[2]]
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    cmd = sys.argv[1]
+    if cmd == "status":
+        print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
+        return
+    if cmd == "obs":
+        result = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+        save_result(r, result, "obs")
+        return
+    if cmd == "hold":
+        seconds = float(sys.argv[2])
+        record({"when": time.time(), "type": "hold", "seconds": seconds,
+                "before": r.status()})
+        result = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, depth=True, video="mp4")
+        save_result(r, result, "hold")
+        return
+    if cmd == "move":
+        x, y, z, yaw, grip = map(float, sys.argv[2:7])
+        target = pose(x, y, z, yaw) + [grip]
+        print("target", np.round(target, 4).tolist())
+        record({"when": time.time(), "type": "ee_pose", "target": target,
+                "before": r.status()})
+        result = r.submit("ee_pose", [target], video="mp4", depth=True,
+                          note=f"move to {x:.3f} {y:.3f} {z:.3f}; yaw {yaw:.1f}; grip {grip:.0f}")
+        save_result(r, result, "move")
+        return
+    raise ValueError(cmd)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print("EPISODE OVER", exc)
+    except Exception:
+        raise
*** End Patch";
